plugins.name: Better Image Viewer
plugins.description: Discord's image viewer, but the arrows go through every image in the channel instead of stopping at the end of the message you clicked.

notes: Faster: opening an image in a long channel does less work.
Uses Discord's own image viewer again instead of replacing it, so zooming, saving, copying, forwarding and the right-click menu work as usual.
Arrows in the viewer now go through every loaded image in the channel.
Spoilers, sensitive media and images from blocked users are left out.
Removed the custom viewer, its rotate and zoom buttons and its settings.
First release.

plugins.name: Claude
plugins.description: Claude Code inside Discord: coding sessions with approvals, diffs and git in your DM sidebar, /claude and friends in any chat, and Discord tools so Claude can read, draft and (with your OK) act for you. Runs your own installed Claude Code (or Codex) on your own login.

notes: Dismissing a /claude reply (or /catchup, /summarize…) removes it for good; it no longer comes back a moment later.
Discord tools always connect: they're now served from inside the plugin, so Claude no longer reports "Connection closed" on Discord builds that won't run as Node.
First release: Coding Agents sessions, slash commands with live replies, Discord tools, Codex support.

plugins.name: Clear URLs
plugins.description: Removes tracking parameters like utm_source and si from links before you send them.

notes: First release.

plugins.name: Emoji Stealer
plugins.description: Right-click a custom emoji, reaction or sticker to add it to one of your servers, with a name check and the slots each server has left. Also copies emoji links and IDs.

notes: The Add to Server dialog opens and closes with Discord's own animation.
First release.

plugins.name: Experiments
plugins.description: Unlocks Discord's Experiments and developer settings tabs.

notes: First release.

plugins.name: Fast Lists
plugins.description: Keeps Discord smooth with hundreds of servers and long chats. Servers, messages and members far out of view skip rendering work, without ever being removed, so nothing flickers, disappears or jumps.

notes: Faster start: the server list's GPU-layer fix is worked out in idle time instead of freezing Discord for a moment.
Servers, messages and members far out of view skip rendering work instead of being removed, so nothing flickers or jumps.

plugins.name: Friend Online Alerts
plugins.description: Get told when the people you pick come online, with a toast, a desktop notification or a sound. Optionally when they go offline, start a game or start streaming.

notes: Lighter on big servers: a burst of status updates reads your watch list once instead of once per person.
First release.

plugins.name: Game Activity Toggle
plugins.description: Show or hide the game you're playing with one click: a gamepad button next to mute and deafen, or /gameactivity.

notes: First release.

plugins.name: GIF Folders
plugins.description: Sort your favourite GIFs into folders. All shows every favourite, Unsorted the ones not in a folder yet, and each folder its own. Right-click a GIF to add it to one, and drag the GIF picker's corner to resize it.

notes: Starting the plugin no longer holds up Discord while it tidies your folders.
All shows every favourite again, and the Unsorted tab (now on by default) shows only the GIFs that aren't in a folder.
Removed the Hide foldered GIFs from All setting and its Show in All and search options: Unsorted does that job.
New setting: Hide foldered GIFs from All. Once a GIF is in a folder it only shows there; tick Show in All on a folder's right-click menu to keep that folder's GIFs in All.
New setting: Search still finds hidden GIFs, so searching in All still turns them up.
New setting: Unsorted tab, listing the favourites that aren't in any folder yet.
New setting: One folder per GIF, so adding a GIF to a folder moves it there.
New setting: Show counts next to tab names.
Fixed: tab text turned black on hover.
Resize the GIF picker by dragging its corner. Double-click the corner to reset; the size is remembered.
Fixed: what you typed while naming or renaming a folder didn't show.
First release.

plugins.name: GPU Zero-Copy
plugins.description: Lets the GPU read rendered tiles directly instead of copying them first (Chromium's zero-copy uploads), which can help high refresh rate displays. Discord already has GPU rendering on; this is the one extra switch it leaves off. Takes effect after restarting Discord.

notes: First release.

plugins.name: Hide Blocked Completely
plugins.description: Blocked users' messages disappear from chat instead of sitting behind "N blocked messages". Ignored users too, and optionally replies to them, the member list and voice channels. /hideblocked toggles it.

notes: Smoother with "Hide replies to them" on: the open chat is only rebuilt when a message one of its replies points to changes.
First release.

plugins.name: Hide Personal Info
plugins.description: Blurs your email, phone, billing details, connected accounts, session locations and IPs in User Settings, for streams and screenshots. Hover or click to reveal.

notes: First release.

plugins.name: Inline Translate
plugins.description: Translate messages right under them, from the message menu or the hover toolbar. Can translate other languages automatically as they arrive.

notes: Smoother: hovering messages no longer re-checks their text each time, and reconnecting no longer redraws every message.
Faster: messages load with no extra work while automatic translation is off, and a finished translation only redraws its own message.
First release.

plugins.name: Last Seen
plugins.description: See when someone was last online, last active and last sent a message: on their profile, next to offline members, in your friends list and in your DMs. Only counts what your client has seen, kept on this device.

notes: Faster: saving what it has seen no longer makes Discord hitch every 30 seconds with a lot of people remembered.
Faster: opening channels and DMs no longer waits on Last Seen, and a change only redraws the lines of the person it is about.
The last seen clock shows in Discord's badge directory (Your badges) too.
Remembers up to 25,000 people, and friends and DM contacts are the last to be forgotten.
Last active: typing, voice and reactions count too, even when someone looks offline.
Opening a channel fills in when people last sent a message there, and hovering says where. Click the clock on a profile to jump to it.
Shows under offline friends in the friends list and under offline people in your DMs.
Times that are only a guess (someone was online when Discord closed) now say "in the last 3h".
Settings: search everyone remembered, export and import, and clearing asks first and can be undone.
First release.

plugins.name: Link Safety
plugins.description: Checks links before they open and warns you about likely scams: masked links that lie about where they go, lookalike domains like dlscord.com or steamcommunlty.com, hidden tricks in the address, free Nitro bait and links to programs.

notes: The warning opens and closes with Discord's own animation.
First release.

plugins.name: Message Logger
plugins.description: Deleted messages stay in the chat, marked as deleted, and edited messages show what they said before. Kept in memory only: nothing is saved, and it's all gone when Discord restarts.

notes: Faster to start: it finds what it needs in Discord without searching all of its code each time.
Right-click a channel, thread, DM or server to clear just its logged messages, without opening settings.
First release.

plugins.name: No Track
plugins.description: Blocks Discord's analytics and metrics requests before they leave your machine.

notes: First release.

plugins.name: Permissions Viewer
plugins.description: Adds View Permissions to user, role, channel and server menus: see every permission someone has in a channel and which role or overwrite granted or denied it.

notes: The dialog opens and closes with Discord's own animation.
A cleaner dialog: permissions are grouped by category, with Granted and Not granted filters, search, and role-colored sources.
First release.

plugins.name: Platform Indicators
plugins.description: Shows whether someone is on desktop, mobile, web or a console: on their profile, next to their name in chat and in the member list.

notes: Faster: in busy servers, presence updates are checked together a few times a second instead of one by one.
Faster: an icon only redraws when that person switches devices, and places you turned off get no icons at all.
One icon per person, for the device they're actually on. A web session left open in the background no longer shows next to their desktop app.
The device shows in Discord's badge directory (Your badges) too.
New icons: a clean outline per device with a status dot, like the one on avatars.
Shows in the member list too, with its own setting.
First release.

plugins.name: Quick Actions
plugins.description: Adds Copy Message Link, Copy Raw Text, Copy Message ID, Search Image (Google Lens, Yandex, TinEye) and Translate with Google to the message menu.

notes: First release.

plugins.name: Read All
plugins.description: Mark every server as read in one click, with a button above the server list, /readall, or the server right-click menu. DMs too if you want.

notes: Smoother: the unread count no longer holds up Discord while it starts, and counts a few servers at a time when the browser is idle.
Faster: the unread count waits for a quiet moment and skips servers with nothing unread, instead of recounting on every message.
First release.

plugins.name: Relationship Notifier
plugins.description: Tells you when someone removes you as a friend, declines your friend request, or removes you from a group DM or server. Kept in memory only: nothing is saved, and the log is gone when Discord restarts.

notes: Faster: when a channel or server goes away, only what's needed to tell whether it concerns you is looked up.
First release.

plugins.name: Show Hidden Channels
plugins.description: Shows the channels you can't view in the channel list, with a lock. Opening one shows its topic, settings and who can see it, never its messages.

notes: Faster: the channel list asks Discord about each channel's permissions once instead of on every redraw.
Faster: a permission change in one server no longer redraws every server's channel list.
Fixes Discord freezing when the plugin is on.
First release.

plugins.name: Silent Typing
plugins.description: Others don't see "is typing…" while you type. Toggle it with /silenttyping or the keyboard button in the chat bar.

notes: Typing stays smooth even if Discord changes its chat bar buttons: the button no longer searches Discord's code on every keystroke.
First release.

plugins.name: Smooth Caret
plugins.description: A text cursor that glides like Word's: it slides smoothly as you type, swipes to wherever you click or arrow to, and blinks with a soft fade instead of flashing on and off. Works in the message box, search and every text field.

notes: First release.

plugins.name: Smooth Typing
plugins.description: Halves the worst frame drops while typing. Discord updates its saved draft on every keystroke, re-rendering everything that shows drafts; this batches those updates until you pause. What you type is never delayed or lost.

notes: Fixed a message you just sent sometimes coming back into the text box, when you sent it right after typing.
First release.

plugins.name: Snippets
plugins.description: Saved replies. Pick one from the chat bar or send it with /snip, with placeholders like {user} and {date}. Right-click a message to save it as a snippet.

notes: Typing stays smooth even if Discord changes its chat bar buttons: the button no longer searches Discord's code on every keystroke.
The snippets menu and the Save as snippet dialog open and close with Discord's own animations.
First release.

plugins.name: Streamer Mode+
plugins.description: Blurs your DMs, servers, chat images and more while you stream, with hover to reveal. Turns on when you go live, with Discord's Streamer Mode, or by hotkey and /streamerplus.

notes: Smoother channel switching: the page's styles are only touched when blurring actually changes.
First release.

plugins.name: Strip Metadata
plugins.description: Removes EXIF, GPS location and other hidden metadata from JPEG, PNG and WebP images before you upload them, without re-encoding. Can also give uploads random file names.

notes: Works with Discord's new upload code again: uploads that skip the upload queue are cleaned too, and the "Can't find 1 part of Discord" warning is gone.
First release.

plugins.name: Timezones
plugins.description: Set someone's timezone from their right-click menu and see their local time next to their name in chat, on their profile and in the member list. Kept on this device.

notes: Smoother chats and profiles: times are formatted without rebuilding a formatter each time, and profiles no longer redraw their badges on every render.
The timezone picker opens and closes with Discord's own animation.
First release.

plugins.name: Video Controls+
plugins.description: Playback speed from 0.25x to 3x, loop, frame stepping and picture-in-picture for videos in chat, plus YouTube-style keyboard shortcuts while you hover a video.

notes: The speed menu slides in like Discord's menus, and fades out instead of vanishing.
First release.

plugins.name: Voice Activity Log
plugins.description: Logs who joins and leaves the voice channel you're in, with times and how long they stayed. Open it from the Voice Connected panel or with /vclog. Memory only.

notes: Faster: voice updates from channels you're not in are skipped right away.
The log scrolls with Discord's slim scrollbar instead of the grey one with arrows.
Faster: a little less work on every voice update.
A cleaner log: sessions are listed by channel with a dot on the one you're in, plus a proper search field and bigger avatars.
Opens and closes with Discord's own dialog animation.
People already in the channel when you join now read "was already here".
First release.

plugins.name: Voice Message Download
plugins.description: Adds Download Voice Message to the message menu of voice messages, saving the recording as an .ogg file.

notes: First release.

plugins.name: Volume Booster
plugins.description: Turn people up past Discord's 200% limit. The volume slider in a user's menu and on stream tiles goes up to 400% by default, or up to 1000% if you set it higher.

notes: First release.

themes.name: Midnight
themes.description: True black backgrounds for OLED screens, with Discord's own accents left as they are.
